result.rationale: Direct Harrison Street, 1547, seller, SEC and current operator evidence establishes one continuing Harrison Street–1547 data-center and connectivity platform. Orangeburg, Pittock Block, Union Station, Wells and Wyoming/Cheyenne are constituent facilities or asset SPVs rather than separate manager-level portfolio companies. Consolidate all five into the existing canonical platform, preserve facility and legal-SPV names as aliases, retain separate Harrison Street and 1547 ownership periods, and do not infer a Harrison Street fund, stake or ownership of corporate 1547.

evidence.purpose: Seller confirmation that Orangeburg and Cheyenne transferred with two other facilities in one November 2021 portfolio sale to the Harrison Street–1547 joint venture.
Harrison Street confirmation of the common portfolio boundary, co-sponsor relationship and continuing 1547 management role.
Official evidence that Wells was the parties' first joint acquisition and part of their digital platform.
Official evidence that Pittock entered the same connectivity-focused platform.
SEC evidence that the Pittock entity is a single-purpose asset borrower sponsored by the Harrison Street–1547 joint venture.
Official evidence that Union Station/South Bend was added beneath the same connected-facilities platform.
Current operator roster showing the target facilities remain in the program and distinguishing sold assets.
April 2026 evidence of continuing joint activity and expansion at Orangeburg.
